item.title: Honoring Kim Sweet: Friends of pilot tragically killed recall memories
item.description: ROGERS, Ark. (KNWA/KFTA) — Close friends of Kim Sweet, the pilot who was killed in a plane crash on Beaver Lake, are honoring his legacy. Terry McCauley and Tim Seratt are longtime friends of Sweet, having worked together to build and fly aircraft. Watch more in the player above.

item.title: Arkansas officials react to U.S., Israel strikes on Iran
item.description: Top Arkansas elected officials have voiced support for the recent military action by the United States and Israel against Iran, calling it a crucial step for regional security.

item.title: 2 Arkansas congressmen briefed ahead of U.S. strikes in Iran
item.description: Sen. Tom Cotton, R-Ark. and U.S. Rep. Rick Crawford, R-Ark were among the eight congressional leaders briefed in advance of the United States’ recent strikes in Iran, representing a quarter of the “Gang of Eight.”

item.title: J.B. Hunt named top domestic intermodal provider in scorecard
item.description: J.B. Hunt Transport Services, Inc. was named the top domestic intermodal provider for the second half of 2025 by the Journal of Commerce Intermodal Service Scorecard.

item.title: Fayetteville city council reschedules meeting due to election
item.description: The Fayetteville City Council will meet Thursday, March 5, after rescheduling its usual Tuesday session for the General Election on March 3.

item.title: Dietz shows off mound potential in Arkansas' 9-0 win over Texas-Arlington
item.description: The two teams will meet Sunday at 11 a.m, for the series win

item.title: UPDATE: Child hospitalized after vehicle-pedestrian crash in Fort Smith
item.description: Fort Smith Police Department responded Sunday afternoon to a vehicle-pedestrian accident in the 9000 block of Dallas Street involving a minor under the age of 10.

item.title: Arkansas State Police arrest Boone County judge on suspicion of abuse of office
item.description: Special agents with the Arkansas State Police Criminal Investigation Division arrested Boone County Judge Robert Daniel Hathaway, 68, on Friday, Feb. 27, according to state police.

item.title: First Visual Night of 2026 at the Medium set for March 6
item.description: The Medium will host its first Visual Art Night of 2026 on Friday, March 6, offering a free evening of exhibitions, open studios and opportunities to meet participating artists in downtown Springdale.

item.title: Fort Smith Police Department wins DOJ photo contest
item.description: The Fort Smith Police Department has been selected as a winner in the U.S. Department of Justice’s 2026 “Uplifting the Image: Highlighting Heroes” Photo Contest.
